patches.value: ∀ (k : ℕ) (j : Fin (k+1)) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → MeasurePreserving (fun p : ℝ × WM.X k => (Fin.insertNth j p.1 p.2 : WM.X (k+1))) volume volume ∧ (Set.image (fun p : ℝ × WM.X k => (Fin.insertNth j p.1 p.2 : WM.X (k+1))) (Set.Icc (-R) R ×ˢ WM.box k R) = WM.box (k+1) R) ∧ (∀ d : WM.X (k+1) → ℝ, Continuous d → (∫ x in WM.box (k+1) R, d x) = ∫ z in WM.box k R, ∫ y in Set.Icc (-R) R, d (Fin.insertNth j y z))
